title: The Art Heist That Shocked Boston

scenes.text: In 1990, thieves pulled off one of the largest art heists ever.
Over $500 million worth of art was stolen, including pieces by Vermeer.
Despite extensive investigations, none of the stolen art has been recovered.
The case remains one of the most famous unsolved art crimes.
Follow because some cases still need answers.

description: The 1990 Boston art heist saw over $500 million worth of masterpieces stolen with no signs of recovery. It stands as one of the most infamous unsolved art crimes in history.
